title: Camera controls fixed
details: The full-screen Evia camera now sits above the app header and bottom progress navigation
Photo capture keeps the evidence prompt visible and the Take photo button accessible
Video capture keeps the prompt, recording timer and Next prompt button visible on the camera screen
Next prompt continues the same recording and preserves the exact prompt timestamp
No Property Maintenance tiles, evidence structure, navigation or other Evia behaviour was changed
summary: Evia v138 fixes the hidden full-screen camera controls.
changes: Raised the capture layer above all Evia chrome
Restored visible Start, Next prompt and Finish recording controls
Moved the offline shell to v138
